notes.title: Class of Heroes 3 Remaster is coming on 18th September 2025!
notes.notes:
[p]If you enjoy the Class of Heroes series, you’ll be pleased to know that [b]Class of Heroes 3: Remaster is coming on 18th September, 2025![/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="kzICEVJisBU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The return of Class of Heroes is near, and the wait is almost over. Grab your school bag and dust off those books, it’s time to step into the shoes of a student once again and enroll in a brand-new academy.[/p][p]This time you will  be able to pick from 3 academies, all offering a wide variety of classes spreading across multiple races. Prepare to dive into challenging quests, sprawling dungeons, and tactical battles against fearsome monsters. Every step forward demands caution and preparation. [/p][p][b]Reminder: Don’t underestimate your enemies, you may not live to regret it![/b][/p][p]Strategic party-building is your key to survival. Level up your students, gather powerful loot, and refine your team along the way. Whether you choose to adventure with the default party or create custom students from scratch, you’ll assign skill points based on race and class, tailoring your strategy to suit your playstyle.[/p][p]Class of Heroes 3 Remaster also introduces a host of new features and enhancements, including a greater item and weapon count to help you through.[/p][p]And for the first time, you’ll be able to build a character relationship chart, choose who your party members like or dislike, and unlock unique abilities and skill sets based on those bonds. Use their relationships to your tactical advantage![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Class of Heroes 3 Remaster is Coming in 2025!
notes.notes:
It’s Official!

Class of Heroes 3 Remaster is coming in 2025!

If you loved playing Class of Heroes: Anniversary Edition, you’re going to love this!

Choose from three different schools to start your adventure, team up with new classmates, and dive into thrilling dungeon-crawling quests. Meet an exciting cast of friends, each offering a wider range of characters and classes to explore.

With endless combinations of races, classes, and gear, you can build your dream team and tackle dungeons packed with epic challenges - an adventure no fan of the series should miss!

Get ready for Class of Heroes 3 Remaster—Coming 2025!

notes.title: How to access the help menu🧑‍🏫
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers,

There have been some queries on accessing the help menu when using keyboard and mouse so we thought we would share a short guide on how to reach the "help" menu from the main menu.

[u][b]"Key" keys:[/b][/u]
[b]Z key:[/b] confirm
[b]X key:[/b] return

[b]Step 1:[/b]
Enter the main menu (after selecting your save file OR completing the intro sequence), and press the [b]"S"[/b] key.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/19e1d482b905d2d12720037cb6cfea1c67b7af00.png[/img]

[b]Step 2:[/b]
This will bring up the "[b]camp menu[/b]" displayed below, from here press the [b]down key[/b] to reach the "[b]help[/b]" bar and press "[b]Z[/b]" to select.
The camp menu can also be accessed from the labyrinth in the same way!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/18a402ac2282c2b814b61fb7a0cc79947290544e.png[/img] 

[b]Step 3:[/b]
This will bring up the below two screens which display a layout for which keys bind to which action on keyboard support.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/d564c0017c71345c0d7edc6e5c55e0807df5122a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/c8442d9e013c7eff5e9625694ad48f28f9ad7fc1.png[/img]

Best of luck with the adventures ahead!

notes.title: Races in Class of Heroes: Anniversary Edition, Part 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/de3969fe6f4c7c74c1fb5cc2e5ec7e648a682963.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/242b161720035c64f498eed04e8a5525dbd70ce5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/34b0b96dd3d320d744bbf09ef2bb4bb089b52aa6.gif[/img]

[b]Elves[/b] are perceived as moderately [b]balanced[/b], with a particular [b]focus on magic[/b]. Their [b]vitality is low[/b], and their [b]HP growth is slow[/b], making it challenging to position them in the frontline. They also [b]lack any special abilities[/b], besides rocking those luscious blonde locks! Looks like they invested a lot of their stat points into haircare!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/ff1a1b5fa30adb682531d0979bee5b76798854ee.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/7be9a79133c2b691675c314b39587f490f6b492e.gif[/img]

While [b]Gnomes[/b] might seem suitable for front-row adventuring, they are ill-suited for that role. They have a significantly [b]low amount of strength[/b], and their [b]HP growth is insufficient[/b]. However, [b]Gnomes[/b] [b]excel in magic[/b] [b]ability, faith,[/b] and [b]wisdom,[/b] making them better suited for back-row positions as support characters.

As[b] Gnomes[/b] are ‘[b]invisible spirits[/b]’, their [b]levitation [/b]act is useful as they will not take damage from [b]shock tiles[/b] on the[b] floor and walls. [/b]This is important to know as all other races wouldn’t be able to avoid these without having a spell cast over them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/0348ec14edb545680d5707be81116a5affa652e0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/a9971aed6f5d7c3fe4b1e354e583a039ce6a3cf6.gif[/img]

[b]Fairies,[/b] the drama queens, that appear magical and enchanting, [b]do not excel in magic[/b] like they do in [b]agility[/b] and [b]luck.[/b] This makes them great choices for [b]agility-based majors[/b] and [b]thievery[/b]. [b]Fairies[/b] have [b]terrible HP growth[/b], it would not be wise to have them leading your party.

Also, just like [b]Gnomes[/b] they can [b]levitate[/b], giving them the upper hand in dodging those pesky [b]shock tiles[/b] on the [b]ground[/b]. But beware! They will not be able to bypass [b]shock walls! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/deac1d72010b6461ac815ab027427e288bee8816.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/82138966cbef6c6d2a482f8caa994aeecc2eb5de.gif[/img]

The Race [b]Celestia[/b] has very [b]high faith[/b] statistics allowing them to be the most [b]perfect healers! [/b] You are trusting them with your party's health so, naturally, keeping them snug in the backline is the only logical choice. After all, we wouldn't want those divine feathers caught in the chaos of combat, now would we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/901284c8030528ad8a46e070740e0c7c815e0ac1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/25771cf00abdcce3f2575be6ee15b090e8017d4a.gif[/img]

[b]Khulaz[/b] are blessed with exceptional [b]agility[/b] and[b] luck[/b] statistics. They may not be the go to for raw power, but when it comes to[b] luck[/b], they're the equivalent to finding a four-leaf clover! They're the perfect addition to any team, destined to be the squad's most adorable, lovable mascot!

Stay tuned for exciting future announcements.

Thankyou,

PQube & Acquire Corp.

notes.title: Races In Class of Heroes: Anniversary Edition, Part 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/3c3f9af688ca12288335e0ebfda7ebaa4bf89039.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/b57e45b1b86aaa668a2a7c6b5cd201cde6e72584.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/b57550929ab638df0d33eececeb176434b898c24.gif[/img]

In comparison to other races, [b]Humans[/b] are regarded as the [b]ultimate generalists[/b]. They are deemed versatile with their capability to adapt to many of the different courses. However, their [b]flexibility[/b] comes at the expense of a reduced life span, due to the [b]absence of a racial skill[/b].

[b]Humans[/b] can obtain a respectable amount of HP, making them a good choice to be at the front of the party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/0af526cb370c4b5c44b0125619652dfe59a40ac0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/6270cade24fa7f66efc7b20086ca91a9a5450fed.gif[/img]

[b]Dwarves[/b] are perceived as a [b]resilient race[/b] known for their tenacious qualities. They excel in [b]strength[/b] and[b] vitality[/b], coupled with [b]high faith[/b]. This makes them excellent candidates for the frontline. You can use this macho-type race an to gain an advantage, due to its wealth of [b]HP[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/39eb73e4417850c17c31fb38312ee32415b20938.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/2b96e41181ef842dfb57fa64262845b422857c87.gif[/img]

[b]Felpurrs[/b] are recognized for their [b]significant strength and vitality[/b], making them formidable frontline adventurers. With their good amount of [b]HP gain[/b] and [b]levelling opportunities[/b] they would be great to have. Their stats are evenly [b]balanced[/b], making them good choices for a range of classes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/78b32190028b972e3b8d3275ff44a6fda4b14dd1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/eeb72c9f4c7080637d990f3c936905fcd8f16606.gif[/img]

[b]Bahamoons[/b] are considered the most [b]typical warrior[/b] type of Race. They have [b]terrible magic statistics, faith, and wisdom[/b], and have[b] awful agility[/b] and [b]luck abilities[/b] too. They do however, [b]over excel[/b] with[b] strength[/b] and [b]vitality[/b], making them nearly unstoppable with great armor and weapons!

[b]Bahamoons[/b] also have an ability called [b]Breath[/b] which is useful on enemies that don’t die by only physical attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/a2425030329a07482b1786dd8bc1f6c813ef9c2f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/50e09073cfd99e6bed9f8c2df793326165ce1f37.png[/img]

[b]Diabolos[/b] can be debated as the [b]Strongest Race![/b] They have[b] excellent HP growth[/b], the same as [b]Dwarves[/b], so would be a perfect fit for frontline! They have good internal vitality and good wisdom. Having these attributes would be well suited for [b]offensive magic [/b]majors.

Additionally, their ability to use[b] Breath [/b]attacks equips them well for handling magical adversaries.


Stay tuned for Part 2, and future announcements.

Thankyou,

PQube & Acquire Corp.

notes.title: Class of Heroes: Anniversary Edition Coming 2024!
notes.notes:
Exciting news Adventures!

Particus Academy is preparing to open its doors for new students in 2024!

Class of Heroes is back, with a remastered anniversary edition! Don’t worry If you missed it the first-time round, it’s never too late to return to education in this classic dungeon crawler.

Build up the dream cohort of students, mixing and matching different races, courses, and alignments. Take classes to learn the tricks of dungeon-hunting and gather your gold to buy the right equipment or use it to resurrect fallen comrades.

School isn't easy, and Particus Academy is no different! Be sure to be prepared for enemies, traps, and even in-fighting!

Wishlists now to be notified on release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758763/196e11f2bdd8806f7a645c3c48cc7dff7fd3e447.png[/img]
